Confirmed: response is {"embeddings":[{"values":[...],"shape":[...]}],"usageMetadata":{"promptTokenCount":N,"promptTokenDetails":[...]}} with no per-item index field (order-preserving only), and authentication is documented via the "x-goog-api-key" HTTP header, not a "?key=" query parameter, for this endpoint.
